extracted.stage: Pre-grant; inheritance tax due before grant of probate
extracted.summary: A solicitor acting for executors of an illiquid Guildford estate valued at around £944,000 enquires about borrowing £73,000 to pay inheritance tax due by 20 October 2026.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry regarding funding for the inheritance tax liability on the Guildford estate. We have logged the details you provided, including the approximate estate value, the sum sought and the HMRC deadline. To progress matters we would need confirmation of the executors' identities and their instructions, a breakdown of the estate's assets and liabilities (including the illiquid elements and any existing charges), the IHT400 or draft figures, and details of how the estate is expected to realise funds. Please also confirm your firm's contact for correspondence. A member of the team will review the information once received and revert to you.
